verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a graphics card, and acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers and uses their tools is a category error for GPU hardware. The pack mentions the G-Assist assistant and local AI model support, but nothing shows MCP client capability, so the wrong-axis exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
